description: Level-3 MOM SegmentResponse (ISA-95 Part 2 / B2MML OperationsResponse.SegmentResponse) = the actuals per manufacturing stage. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md, description.

properties.name: segment_response_no
properties.description: Identity of the SegmentResponse (join key): its own number from the source system. It is never built from other keys; the operations response is reached through operations_response_ref (core 4.0.0, F3).

properties.name: operations_response_ref
properties.description: FK to OperationsResponse.production_order_no (PART_OF). The order actuals to which these segment actuals belong.

properties.name: segment_requirement_ref
properties.description: FK to SegmentRequirement.segment_requirement_no (RESPONDS_TO). The target segment whose actuals are reported here.

properties.name: process_segment_ref
properties.description: FK to ProcessSegment.process_segment_no (FOR_PROCESS_SEGMENT). Which manufacturing stage was executed.

properties.name: sequence
properties.description: Sequence of this segment within the order.

properties.name: material_lot_ref
properties.description: FK to MaterialLot.material_lot_no (ACTUAL_MATERIAL) = MaterialActual.MaterialLotID. The material lot actually consumed/produced; role via material_use.

properties.name: material_use
properties.description: ISA-95 MaterialActual.MaterialUse — the ROLE of the material (actual). Mirrors the SegmentRequirement role.

properties.name: qty_actual
properties.description: Actual quantity of this material role (actual). Counterpart to SegmentRequirement.qty_planned.

properties.name: unit_of_measure
properties.description: Unit of measure of qty_actual.

properties.name: equipment_ref
properties.description: FK to Machine.machine_id (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT; Machine ≡ Unit level) = EquipmentActual.EquipmentID. The equipment actually used.

properties.name: actual_start_time
properties.description: Actual stage start (actual).

properties.name: actual_end_time
properties.description: Actual stage end (actual).

properties.name: status
properties.description: Actual status of the stage (e.g. running, complete, aborted). Derived from the MES OrderState.

properties.name: qty_good
properties.description: Good parts counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: qty_scrap
properties.description: Scrap parts counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: qty_total
properties.description: All parts (good + scrap) counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: program_ref
properties.description: The NC or machine program the machine reports as active. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: core 2.0.0 has no edge for it yet.

properties.name: tool_ref
properties.description: The tool or mould the machine reports as set up for the order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: qty_rework
properties.description: Parts sent to rework, counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: production_order_ref
properties.description: The production order the machine reports it is running. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: article_ref
properties.description: The article the machine reports it is producing. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: article_revision
properties.description: The revision of the article that was built or used, where the source's article number carries none (a PLM part number with revision A). Empty when the number itself names the revision (at SAP dddd.1).

properties.name: recipe_ref
properties.description: The recipe the order ran with (its recipeId in sites/<site>/recipes).

refStatus.reason: A recipe is a released git file (sites/<site>/recipes, R3), no profile of ours — B2MML 0701 has no field for it on a response; kept as a value for traceability (R5).

properties.name: recipe_version
properties.description: The released version (semver) of that recipe.

properties.name: program_line
properties.description: The active line of the running program. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: program_status
properties.description: The state of the running program (running, stopped, …). Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

properties.name: equipment_class_ref
properties.description: The EquipmentClass (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → EquipmentClass). Optional.

properties.name: material_class_ref
properties.description: The MaterialClass (ACTUAL_MATERIAL; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → MaterialClass). Optional.

properties.name: quant_ref
properties.description: The Quant (ACTUAL_MATERIAL; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → MaterialSubLot). Optional.

properties.name: person_ref
properties.description: The Person (ACTUAL_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → Person). Optional.

properties.name: personnel_class_ref
properties.description: The PersonnelClass (ACTUAL_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → PersonnelClass). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_class_ref
properties.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (ACTUAL_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

properties.name: job_response_ref
properties.description: The JobResponse (DETAILED_BY; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → JobResponse). Optional.

properties.name: work_response_ref
properties.description: The WorkResponse (DETAILED_BY; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → WorkResponse). Optional.

properties.name: operations_definition_ref
properties.description: The OperationsDefinition (FOR_OPERATIONS_DEFINITION; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → OperationsDefinition). Optional.

properties.name: operations_definition_version
properties.description: The version of the operations definition this order / response ran with, where the source's definition id carries none (a routing number with its own change state). Empty when the id itself names the version.

properties.name: operations_segment_ref
properties.description: The OperationsSegment (FOR_OPERATIONS_SEGMENT; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → OperationsSegment). Optional.

properties.name: inspection_lot_ref
properties.description: The InspectionLot — the test result of a material actual (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → MaterialActual → TestResult). Optional.

properties.name: personnel_test_result_ref
properties.description: The TestResult of a person (qualification test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → PersonnelActual → TestResult). Optional.

properties.name: equipment_test_result_ref
properties.description: The TestResult of a machine (equipment capability test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → EquipmentActual → TestResult). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_test_result_ref
properties.description: The TestResult of a tool (physical asset capability test) the response used (HAS_TEST_RESULT; ISA-95 SegmentResponse → PhysicalAssetActual → TestResult). Optional.

properties.name: parent_segment_response_ref
properties.description: The SegmentResponse this SegmentResponse is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 SegmentResponse MADE_UP_OF SegmentResponse). Optional.

properties.name: source_quality
properties.description: Quality the source reported for this record: the worst OPC UA StatusCode (Good / Uncertain / Bad) of the fields the edge read for it. Left out when the source reports none (ERP REST). A field of the record, not the telemetry quality facet (learning T10).

properties.name: operations_type
properties.description: ISA-95 operations type (B2MML OperationsType; Part 3/4: which MOM area the object belongs to; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

relationships.description: The order actuals that contain these segment actuals.
The executed manufacturing stage (= plant = Function).
The material lot consumed/produced; role via material_use.
The equipment actually used (Machine ≡ Unit level, consolidation 2026-07-15 — the source fkColumn carries machine ids).
ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 6.2/6.3 (B2MML SegmentResponse.PersonnelActual / EquipmentActual / PhysicalAssetActual.TestResult): the result of a resource test.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 OperationsResponse.SegmentResponse = actuals per ProcessSegment, with MaterialActual (MaterialUse=role, MaterialLot) + EquipmentActual. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: sequence is carried by B2MML through the order of SegmentResponse in OperationsResponse; B2MML has one quantity per material actual, no good/scrap/total/rework split, and no NC program, program line or program state. source_quality: data quality of the record as its source reported it; ISA-95 has no element for it. Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent). Audit M3 (core 6.0.0): qty_good is the produced MaterialActual (MaterialUse Produced); program_ref / program_line / program_status are SegmentData entries named by their ID; qty_scrap / qty_rework / qty_total stay ours (no MaterialUse for scrap or rework in B2MML 0701). PLM as-built (owner 29.10.2026): operations_definition_version and article_revision name the state that was built where the source's id carries none; B2MML references a definition by its ID alone (an ID means one state), so there is no field for it — an extension, never part of the key. recipe_ref / recipe_version (0.7.0 R5): the git recipe and its released version the order ran with — B2MML has no field for a recipe file on a response, so they are extensions for traceability.

keyStability.note: confirmation_no is the ERP's own primary key of the confirmation row (erp-segment-responses primaryKeyColumns, core 4.0.0); the key moves only when the ERP row does.
